verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; cost per lead is being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 42 leads at an average cost of $28.05 per lead, but the most recent week showed a steep pullback — lead volume fell while cost per lead rose sharply, meaning the same ad spend produced fewer results. The drop is concentrated in two places: Google Ads is delivering leads at a significantly higher cost than Meta, and your Google Business Profile activity collapsed to near zero in the final days of the period after strong organic engagement in late October. We're reallocating budget toward Meta where your cost per lead is performing better, and we're investigating the Business Profile drop to restore that organic call and direction volume. Next period you should see cost per lead stabilize as the channel mix shifts and the Business Profile is brought back to its prior activity level.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead spiked sharply in the most recent week as Google Ads conversion efficiency dropped and Business Profile organic activity fell to near zero.
watch_item.fix: Budget is being shifted toward Meta, which is producing leads at a fraction of Google's current cost, and the Business Profile is being reviewed to recover the call and direction volume seen in late October.
